# Vila Emes

> A family-run hotel by the Adriatic in Plazh, Durrës, Albania. 100 m from the beach, 35 km from Tirana International Airport. 9 room layouts (17 physical rooms), 9.0/10 on Booking.com, 4.7/5 on Google. Operating since 1998.

The site is published in 4 languages: English (default, no URL prefix), Albanian (`/al/`), Italian (`/it/`), and German (`/de/`). All rooms include a private bathroom with shower (no bathtubs), air conditioning, and free Wi-Fi.

Bookings are handled exclusively on Booking.com. The site has no on-page reservation system; call-to-action buttons link out to Booking.com, WhatsApp, Google Maps, Instagram, email, and phone.

## Pages

- [Home — English](https://www.vilaemes.com/): Overview, hero, highlights, ready-to-book section
- [Home — Albanian](https://www.vilaemes.com/al/): Same content in Albanian (Shqip)
- [Home — Italian](https://www.vilaemes.com/it/): Same content in Italian
- [Home — German](https://www.vilaemes.com/de/): Same content in German
- [Rooms — English](https://www.vilaemes.com/rooms/): 9 room categories with photos, sizes (m²), bed configurations, and amenities
- [Rooms — Albanian](https://www.vilaemes.com/al/rooms/)
- [Rooms — Italian](https://www.vilaemes.com/it/rooms/)
- [Rooms — German](https://www.vilaemes.com/de/rooms/)
- [Contact — English](https://www.vilaemes.com/contact/): Phone, WhatsApp, email, address, embedded map, check-in/check-out hours
- [Contact — Albanian](https://www.vilaemes.com/al/contact/)
- [Contact — Italian](https://www.vilaemes.com/it/contact/)
- [Contact — German](https://www.vilaemes.com/de/contact/)

## Location

- Address: Rruga Pavarësia, Plazh, Durrës 2001, Albania
- Coordinates: 41.308487, 19.485100
- 100 m from Durrës Beach (2-minute walk through the palm-lined avenue)
- 3.5 km from the centre of Durrës (city buses every 10 minutes)
- 5 km from Durrës Amphitheatre (10-minute drive; 2nd-century Roman ruins)
- 35 km from Tirana International Airport (~35 minutes in light traffic)
